---
pagetitle: "`r source(here::here('R/legislature/session.R')); x <- readRDS(file.path(ga_paths(resolve_ga(params$ga))$lobbying, 'clients.rds')); paste(x$client_name[x$client_slug == params$slug][1], '– Lobbying')`"
format:
  html:
    echo: false
    message: false
    warning: false
    toc: false

params:
  slug: "iowa-medical-society"
  ga: null  # General Assembly; null = CURRENT_GA
---

```{r}
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(purrr)
library(stringr)
library(htmltools)
source(here::here("R/legislature/utils.R"))
source(here::here("R/legislature/ui_helpers.R"))

ga <- resolve_ga(params$ga)
```

```{r}
# Organization-page data from 04b / 04c / 04a (R/legislature/)
lobbying_dir <- ga_paths(ga)$lobbying
read_lobbying <- \(name) readRDS(file.path(lobbying_dir, paste0(name, ".rds")))

client <- read_lobbying("clients") |> filter(client_slug == params$slug)
org_name <- client$client_name[1]
is_personal <- client$client_type[1] == "personal"

org_bills <- read_lobbying("organization_bills") |> filter(client_slug == params$slug)
org_outcomes <- read_lobbying("organization_outcomes") |> filter(client_slug == params$slug)
baseline <- read_lobbying("outcome_baseline")
lobbyists <- read_lobbying("organization_lobbyists") |> filter(client_slug == params$slug)
alignment <- read_lobbying("legislator_client_alignment_all") |>
  filter(client %in% !!client$client)

bills_csv <- read_csv(ga_csv("bills", ga), show_col_types = FALSE)
people <- read_csv(ga_csv("people", ga), show_col_types = FALSE)

fmt_date <- \(d) str_squish(format(d, "%b %e, %Y"))
fmt_bill <- \(b) str_replace(b, "^([A-Z]+)(\\d+)$", "\\1 \\2")
plural <- \(n, word) paste(format(n, big.mark = ","), if (n == 1) word else paste0(word, "s"))
pct <- \(x) if_else(is.na(x), "—", paste0(round(100 * x), "%"))

position_counts <- org_bills |> count(position, .drop = FALSE)
n_position <- \(p) position_counts$n[position_counts$position == p]
```

```{r}
div(class = "ia-breadcrumb", a(href = "../index.html", "← All organizations"))

div(class = "ia-card",
  div(class = "ia-bill-eyebrow-row",
    span(class = "ia-bill-eyebrow",
         toupper(if (is_personal) "Lobbying for personal interest" else "Lobbying organization"))
  ),
  h1(class = "ia-bill-title", org_name),
  div(class = "ia-bill-meta",
    span(HTML(sprintf("Declared on <strong>%s</strong>", plural(nrow(org_bills), "bill")))),
    span(HTML(sprintf("<strong>%s</strong>", plural(nrow(lobbyists), "lobbyist")))),
    span(HTML(sprintf("Last declaration <strong>%s</strong>", fmt_date(max(org_bills$date))))),
    span(ga_label(ga))
  ),
  div(style = "margin-top:1rem; max-width:640px",
    {
      # Withdrawn is rare; leave it out of the legend unless it happened
      segments <- c(For = n_position("For"), Against = n_position("Against"),
                    Undecided = n_position("Undecided"), Withdrawn = n_position("Withdrawn"))
      if (segments[["Withdrawn"]] == 0) segments <- segments[names(segments) != "Withdrawn"]
      ui_share_bar(
        segments,
        c(For = IA_PALETTE$lobby_for, Against = IA_PALETTE$lobby_against,
          Undecided = IA_PALETTE$lobby_undecided, Withdrawn = IA_PALETTE$border)
      )
    }
  )
)
```

::: {.ia-card}
::: {.ia-card-title}
How its bills turned out
:::
::: {.ia-card-sub}
Where each bill ended up, next to the rate across every organization's declarations this session. Many forces decide a bill; this doesn't show that the organization's position caused the outcome. Substantive bills only: resolutions nearly always pass.
:::

```{r}
MIN_RATE_BILLS <- 5  # fewer bills than this in a position: show a count, not a rate

signed_share <- function(df, position) {
  row <- df |> filter(position == !!position, outcome == "Signed into law")
  list(n = row$n, total = row$n_position, share = row$share)
}

position_card <- function(position, label) {
  org <- signed_share(org_outcomes, position)
  all <- signed_share(baseline, position)
  if (org$total == 0) return(NULL)
  # A percentage of one or two bills overstates the evidence; show the count
  if (org$total < MIN_RATE_BILLS) {
    return(ui_stat_card(
      label,
      sprintf("%d of %d", org$n, org$total),
      HTML(sprintf("became law &middot; all organizations: %s", pct(all$share)))
    ))
  }
  ui_stat_card(
    label,
    pct(org$share),
    HTML(sprintf("%d of %d became law &middot; all organizations: %s",
                 org$n, org$total, pct(all$share)))
  )
}

if (sum(org_outcomes$n) == 0) {
  ui_empty("This organization declared only on resolutions, so there are no bill outcomes to show.")
} else {
  outcome_table <- org_outcomes |>
    filter(n_position > 0) |>
    select(position, outcome, n, n_position) |>
    tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = outcome, values_from = n) |>
    relocate(n_position, .after = last_col()) |>
    mutate(position = map(as.character(position), position_pill))

  tagList(
    ui_stat_grid(
      position_card("For", "Bills it supported"),
      position_card("Against", "Bills it opposed"),
      position_card("Undecided", "Bills where it was undecided")
    ),
    div(class = "ia-card-sub", style = "margin-top:1.25rem",
        "Number of bills, by its position and how far the bill got"),
    ui_table(
      outcome_table,
      labels = c(position = "Position", n_position = "Total"),
      numeric = setdiff(names(outcome_table), "position")
    )
  )
}
```

::: {.ia-card}
::: {.ia-card-title}
Positions on bills
:::
::: {.ia-card-sub}
`r plural(nrow(org_bills), "bill")`, newest declaration first. Type "Against" or a word from a title to filter. A bill renumbered in committee is listed under its final number.
:::

```{r}
bill_prefix <- bill_dir_href(ga, up = 2)
# Short titles: appropriations titles run to hundreds of words, and the bill
# page has the full text
titles <- bills_csv |>
  transmute(
    lead_bill = bill_number,
    title = map_chr(title, \(t) clean_bill_title(t)$title) |>
      str_remove("\\s*\\(See [^)]*\\)\\.?") |>
      str_trunc(160, ellipsis = "…")
  )

positions_df <- org_bills |>
  left_join(titles, by = "lead_bill") |>
  mutate(
    via = map2_chr(bills_declared, lead_bill, \(b, lead) {
      other <- setdiff(b, lead)
      if (length(other) == 0) "" else paste("declared on", paste(fmt_bill(other), collapse = ", "))
    })
  ) |>
  transmute(
    lead_bill,
    bill = fmt_bill(lead_bill),
    via, title,
    position = as.character(position),
    stage,
    date = as.Date(date)
  )

bill_cell_js <- reactable::JS(sprintf(
  "function(cell) {
     const via = cell.row.via ? '<div class=\"ia-recent-meta\">' + cell.row.via + '</div>' : '';
     return '<a href=\"%s' + cell.row.lead_bill + '.html\">' + cell.value + '</a>' + via;
   }",
  bill_prefix
))
date_js <- reactable::JS(
  "function(cell) {
     if (!cell.value) return '—';
     return new Date(cell.value).toLocaleDateString('en-US',
       { month: 'short', day: 'numeric', year: 'numeric', timeZone: 'UTC' });
   }"
)

reactable::reactable(
  positions_df,
  columns = list(
    lead_bill = reactable::colDef(show = FALSE),
    via = reactable::colDef(show = FALSE),
    bill = reactable::colDef(name = "Bill", minWidth = 100, html = TRUE, cell = bill_cell_js),
    title = reactable::colDef(name = "Title", minWidth = 300, sortable = FALSE),
    position = reactable::colDef(name = "Position", minWidth = 100, html = TRUE,
                                 cell = position_pill_js),
    stage = reactable::colDef(name = "Where it ended up", minWidth = 150, html = TRUE,
                              cell = status_pill_js),
    date = reactable::colDef(name = "Declared", minWidth = 110, cell = date_js)
  ),
  defaultSorted = list(date = "desc"),
  searchable = TRUE,
  defaultPageSize = 25,
  highlight = TRUE
)
```

::: {.ia-card}
::: {.ia-card-title}
Lobbyists
:::
::: {.ia-card-sub}
Registered lobbyists who filed declarations for `r if (is_personal) "this client" else "this organization"`. Registration details are on the Legislature's site.
:::

```{r}
lobbyist_href <- \(id) sprintf(
  "https://www.legis.iowa.gov/lobbyist/reports/lobbyist?personID=%s&ga=%d", id, ga)

ui_table(
  lobbyists |>
    arrange(desc(n_bills), lobbyist) |>
    transmute(
      lobbyist = map2(lobbyist, lobbyist_id, \(name, id)
        a(href = lobbyist_href(id), target = "_blank", rel = "noopener", name)),
      n_bills,
      first = fmt_date(first_date),
      last = fmt_date(last_date)
    ),
  labels = c(lobbyist = "Lobbyist", n_bills = "Bills", first = "First declaration",
             last = "Last declaration"),
  numeric = "n_bills",
  nowrap = c("first", "last"),
  empty = "No lobbyists on record."
)
```

:::

::: {.ia-card}
::: {.ia-card-title}
Legislators whose votes matched its positions
:::
::: {.ia-card-sub}
On bills where `r if (is_personal) "this client" else "the organization"` was for or against and a legislator cast a final floor vote: how often the vote went the same way. Legislators with fewer than five such votes are left out.
:::

```{r}
if (nrow(alignment) == 0) {
  ui_empty("Too few of its bills reached a floor vote to compare with legislators' votes.")
} else {
  legislator_prefix <- "../../legislators/"
  alignment_table <- function(df) {
    ui_table(
      df |>
        transmute(
          legislator = map2(people_id, name, \(id, nm) a(
            href = paste0(legislator_prefix, get_legislator_filename(id, people), ".html"), nm)),
          seat = paste0(party, "-", district),
          matched = sprintf("%d of %d", n_aligned, n_shared),
          rate = pct(alignment)
        ),
      labels = c(legislator = "Legislator", seat = "Party and district",
                 matched = "Votes matched", rate = "Rate"),
      numeric = c("matched", "rate"),
      nowrap = c("seat", "matched")
    )
  }
  n_show <- min(5, ceiling(nrow(alignment) / 2))
  tagList(
    h3(class = "ia-card-sub", style = "margin-top:0.5rem", "Most often matched"),
    alignment_table(alignment |> arrange(desc(alignment), desc(n_shared)) |> head(n_show)),
    h3(class = "ia-card-sub", style = "margin-top:1.25rem", "Least often matched"),
    alignment_table(alignment |> arrange(alignment, desc(n_shared)) |> head(n_show)),
    div(class = "ia-footnote", sprintf(
      "%s compared. A bill that passed both chambers counts once per chamber's vote.",
      plural(nrow(alignment), "legislator")))
  )
}
```
